text: Meredith Kratzmann, Manager, Policy and Program Planning, and Sara Korosi, Senior Strategic Policy Consultant, Housing Secretariat, will provide a presentation on the City’s plans to conduct an independent assessment of the City’s progress in advancing its Toronto Housing Charter commitment to progressively realize the right to adequate housing at the midpoint of its 10-year HousingTO Action Plan.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee received the item for information.
